citation_details.title: TX15
citation_details.author: Gabriella Larkin, James A. Davis, Victor Paul, Marcel Cannon, Chris Manteuffel, Ben Brewster, Tony Johnson, Mike Dunkel, Stephen Gordon, Kevin King
citation_details.abstract: TX15 is a BIDS-formatted EEG dataset (BIDS version 1.8.0) with HED (Hierarchical Event Descriptors) version 8.1.0 annotations. The dataset includes EEG recordings and associated metadata in standardized formats (.set, .fdt, .tsv, .json). This dataset is derived from OpenNeuro dataset ds004842 (v1.0.0) and has been processed and annotated with HED tags to support standardized neuroimaging research. Released under the CC0 license, this dataset is made openly available to support reproducible science and neuroimaging research.
